Mode.Name: Send phones to the mobile app
Mode.Hint: When a touch device with a narrow screen opens the regular Foundry client, redirect it to the Elfrey Pocket App app page (modules/elfrey-pocket-app/app.html). On/Off force the behaviour regardless of the device. Can also be set per session with ?mobile=1 or ?mobile=0 in the /game URL.

Breakpoint.Name: Auto-detect width threshold (px)
Breakpoint.Hint: In Auto mode a touch device is treated as a phone when the viewport is not wider than this value.

FastRoll.Name: Fast rolls
FastRoll.Hint: Skip the dnd5e roll configuration dialog for checks, saves and skills. Also toggled with the ⚡ button in the app.

Theme.Name: Theme
Theme.Hint: Colour theme of the mobile app. Also switchable from the ⋮ menu in the app.

Haptics.Name: Vibration on rolls
Haptics.Hint: A short vibration when rolling or using items (Android).

ForcedUsers.Name: Players sent to the mobile app
ForcedUsers.Label: Choose players
ForcedUsers.Hint: These players always land in Elfrey Pocket App when they open /game, whatever device they use.
ForcedUsers.Title: Elfrey Pocket App: players
ForcedUsers.Intro: Checked players are redirected to the mobile app when they open the regular client.

AppUrl.Name: App URL
AppUrl.Hint: Where the app page is served from, relative to the Foundry root. Leave empty for automatic: Foundry v13 → modules/elfrey-pocket-app/app.html; Foundry v14 → pocket/app.html (after running tools/install-v14 on the server, see README).

Relay.Name: Use items through the GM's client
Relay.Hint: Item and spell uses started in the app are executed on the GM's Foundry client, so midi-qol and the modules built on it (DAE, CPR…) process them. Auto = only while midi-qol is enabled in the world. Requires a GM online; the app picks targets from a list, since it has no map.

Notify.NotDnd5e: Elfrey Pocket App only works with the dnd5e system.

Picker.NoCharacters: You don't own any character yet. Ask the GM to assign one, then reload.

More.Pick: Pick a section from the “More” menu.

Actions.Empty: Nothing to use yet — items and spells with activities will show up here.
Actions.NoAttack: This activity has no attack roll.
Actions.NoDamage: This activity has no damage roll.

Relay.Sent: Sent to the GM — the card will appear in chat.
Relay.NoGM: No GM online — used locally, without midi-qol.
Relay.Timeout: {name} did not answer. Is their Foundry client open?
Relay.Denied: You do not own this character.
Relay.NotFound: The item or activity was not found on the GM's side.
Relay.SceneMismatch: The GM is viewing another scene — the chosen targets are not on it.
Relay.Failed: The GM's client could not use the item: {error}
Relay.CompleteTimeout: The GM's client did not finish the action in time.
Relay.NoScene: The GM has no scene open.

Targets.Title: Targets
Targets.Area: Area — mark the creatures caught in it
Targets.Empty: No visible tokens on this scene.
Targets.Judged: visible and in range, as seen from your token
Targets.NoToken: Your character has no token on the GM's scene — everything is listed, unchecked.
Targets.NoGMAnswer: The GM did not answer — listing the scene without checking sight or range.
Targets.ShowFar: Show all visible ({count} out of range)

Bridge.ReactionNoRelay: Cannot react from the phone: the GM relay is off or no GM is online.
Bridge.RollRequested: The GM asks {actor} to roll — see the dialog.

Inventory.CurrencyHint: Type +11 or -11 to add or spend, a plain number to set.

Spells.NoneReady: No spells are prepared — switch to “All” to prepare some.
Spells.PrepareEmpty: This character has no spells that need preparing.

Favorites.Hint: Mark items, spells, skills or slots as favorites on the full sheet — they show up here.

Journal.TidyHint: Shared with Tidy 5e Sheet — the same journal as on the full sheet.

Chat.AddDie: Add a die (tap the badge to remove one)
